title: A Systems Biology and Drug Repositioning Approach for the Analysis of Mutual Genes Between Celiac Disease and Irritable Bowel Syndrome.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过系统生物学分析乳糜泻与肠易激综合征共享基因，虽涉及转录因子调控和分子对接，但核心是疾病基因表达与药物重定位，非蛋白质-DNA互作机制研究，方法上仅用Enrichr和DrupRep，无AI或物理模拟建模。
abstract: Celiac disease (CD) and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) are two disorders that share common features, such as similar symptoms and autoimmune involvement. However, the molecular genetic mechanisms underlying their pathogenesis remain unclear. An in silico systems biology approach was performed to analyze the RNA-seq (GSE146190 and GSE166869) and microarray data (GSE164883 and GSE63379) of both diseases. Gene ontology was first identified, followed by transcriptional factors and miRNAs that regulate the mutual genes by Enrichr platform. Moreover, a protein-protein interaction network of the shared genes was constructed, and the hub genes were identified using Network Analyst and Cytoscape. Finally, the tertiary structure of the most significant hub gene product was downloaded and screened against approved drugs using DrupRep server for drug repurposing. Four hundred thirty-nine shared genes between CD and IBS were revealed, which were mainly involved in response to stimulus, proliferation regulation, metabolism of small molecules, and apoptosis. RARG, NFE2L2, VDR, NCOA1, and RXRA were the top five transcription factors that regulated these genes, whereas hsa-miR-4632-3p, hsa-miR-598-5p, hsa-miR-7108-3p, and hsa-miR-29b-3p were the top five miRNAs. SRC, STAT1, CCNB1, CDK1, CD44, RRM2, ERBB2, BUB1B, KIF11, and TOP2A were ranked as the Top 10 hub genes by the PPI network analysis. Temoporfin, rimegepant, and eltrombopag were suggested as the top three lead candidates by the virtual screening against SRC with binding affinities of -11.1, 10.9, and -10.8 kcal/mol, respectively. These drugs are potential SRC inhibitors that warrant further experimental validation. Novel insights into the molecular genetic mechanisms of CD and IBS and new therapeutic avenues for these disorders were provided by this study.
abstract_zh: 乳糜泻（CD）和肠易激综合征（IBS）是两种具有共同特征的疾病，例如相似的症状和自身免疫参与。然而，其发病机制背后的分子遗传机制仍不清楚。采用计算机系统生物学方法分析了这两种疾病的RNA-seq（GSE146190和GSE166869）及微阵列数据（GSE164883和GSE63379）。首先进行了基因本体论鉴定，随后通过Enrichr平台识别了调控共同基因的转录因子和miRNA。此外，构建了共享基因的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络，并使用Network Analyst和Cytoscape鉴定了枢纽基因。最后，下载了最显著枢纽基因产物的三级结构，并通过DrupRep服务器针对已批准药物进行筛选，以实现药物再利用。研究揭示了CD和IBS之间的439个共享基因，这些基因主要涉及刺激反应、增殖调控、小分子代谢和凋亡。RARG、NFE2L2、VDR、NCOA1和RXRA是调控这些基因的前五位转录因子，而hsa-miR-4632-3p、hsa-miR-598-5p、hsa-miR-7108-3p和hsa-miR-29b-3p是前五位miRNA。通过PPI网络分析，SRC、STAT1、CCNB1、CDK1、CD44、RRM2、ERBB2、BUB1B、KIF11和TOP2A被列为前十位枢纽基因。针对SRC的虚拟筛选建议替莫泊芬、瑞美吉泮和艾曲泊帕为前三位先导候选药物，其结合亲和力分别为-11.1、10.9和-10.8 kcal/mol。这些药物是潜在的SRC抑制剂，值得进一步的实验验证。本研究为CD和IBS的分子遗传机制提供了新的见解，并为这些疾病开辟了新的治疗途径。
